cases.instruction: Make me a Terminal Os — Terminal OS.
cases.output_preview:
# Terminal OS

> Terminal OS. A minimal, terminal-based operating system with a focus on simplicity and efficiency.

## Features

- Minimal, terminal-based interface
- Built-in shell with command completion
- File system management
- Networking (TCP/UDP)
- Process management
- Basic IPC (pipes, signals)
- Simple kernel (40+ files)

## Getting Started

### Building

```sh
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/your-repo/terminal-os.git
cd terminal-os

# Build the kernel
make
```
